Synopsis:
During the scene where she scratches you. Nettie is in the lab, sitting at a table, studiying Halsin's notes. The player can still try to persuade her to give the antidote. The player must also accept to take the wyvern poison. The other choice is to kill Nettie.

Cluster Contexts:
- DEN_Apprentice_LockedUp.json: This scene takes place in Nettie’s lab after she scratched the player; she’s sitting over Halsin’s notes and is visibly torn about how to handle the player’s illithid infection. Nettie worships Silvanus and believes infected people must be ended rather than cured, so she initially refuses to hand over an antidote but will reveal its location if the player swears to kill themselves at the first sign of turning. Off‑screen the player has already removed the wyvern poison from Nettie’s supplies (so she can’t simply give it), and the dialogue branches let the player try to persuade her, accept taking the wyvern poison, or resort to killing Nettie. Nettie also frets about Halsin — she fears he may “turn” too and hopes prompt action could save him.
- DEN_Apprentice_Cyanide.json: Nettie leads the player into a lab and fetches a thorn. The player doesn't know, but the thorn is a deadly poison. Nettie knows it's the only choice she has - the player could transform into a monster and kill everyone in the camp. She sees this as a kindness - the transformation is terrible - so she has a very 'matter of fact nurse' tone about the whole thing before she scratches you, but will get stressed if you resist. Once she's scratched the player, her tone will be softer - kinder. She plans to sit with you while you pass and make it as easy as possible. The player will have to convince her they're not a threat if they're going to get the antidote. She'll be slow to convince, hesitant to allow any risk to the camp. Nettie is STANDING for this entire dialog.
- DEN_Apprentice_Stayed.json: After the scene where she scratches you. Player persuaded Nettie and accepted to take her poison. She told them their only hope is Halsin. Nettie is back in her room, she's working.
- DEN_CGB_Apprentice.json: The player is locked in Nettie's lab and has done something to annoy her (ie. Stolen, damaged, or moved something she owned, or been caught trying to pick her pocket.) Nettie has poisoned the player, and is wary of you finding the antidote while looking around.
- DEN_Apprentice.json: Nettie is the apprentice of Halsin, the missing druid. We can tell her about the parasite in our heads. She listens with compassion but decides the player is too dangerous and must be quarantined. If she knows about the parasite, she'll invite the player to come with her deeper into her rooms for "treatement."

- Nettie: Aside from the obvious. || [context] NodeContext: A little sadly. She wants to save you, but feels that she morally can't. (node 128)
- Player: You can't do this - I'm on a secret mission. Everything depends on it. (node 138)
- : False (node 82)
- Nettie: It doesn't matter if you're Silvanus himself come to walk among us - infected is infected. || [context] NodeContext: Sill-van-us, the god Nettie worships (node 110)
- Nettie: Same as the drow... But Master Halsin said he'd turn eventually. || [context] NodeContext: Considering (node 102)
- Player: I know where Halsin is! Give me the antidote or he'll die too! (node 62)
- Nettie: Hells' teeth. All right. I'll tell you where the antidote is, but there's a condition. || [context] NodeContext: Realises that if she acts quickly, she can save her mentor. (node 145)
- Nettie: Swear to me that if you feel any symptoms, you'll end things yourself. || [context] NodeContext: 'you'll end things yourself' = you'll kill yourself. (node 105)
- Nettie: And? Will you swear you'd die before you turn? || [context] InternalNodeContext: She doesn't have the wyvern poison in her inventory, player pickpocketed it already (node 51)
- Player: I swear, Nettie. (node 93)

context: Nettie is in her lab, sitting over Halsin’s notes and visibly torn after scratching the player and infecting them with an illithid parasite. She’s Halsin’s druid apprentice and a devout follower of Silvanus who believes the infected must be ended rather than risk turning others, so she initially refuses to hand over an antidote. Off‑screen the player has already taken Nettie’s wyvern poison from her supplies, so she can’t simply give it, but she will reveal the antidote’s location only if the player swears to kill themselves at the first sign of turning. Dialogue branches let the player try to persuade her, accept taking the poison or other terms, or resort to killing Nettie; Nettie also frets that Halsin himself may yet “turn.”
